programme.title: 大灣區美味好玩攻略粵
programme.desc: 郭柏姸、港姐師妹鄧凱文參加新一趟灣區之旅。來到惠州，麥包、美儀於太平洋相伴下淺嚐輕食，好寫意。四人在無敵海景旁享用海產，更是倍添鮮味。置身仿似歐洲小鎮的景區，主持們分途學造朱古力、玻璃杯，再牽手漫步玻璃橋。在盛大場景體驗劇本殺，又是甚麼玩法？生態園區內「自駕遊」，除了欣賞花卉美景之外，也可親親動物。入夜後，坐船觀看光影秀，讓眾人目不暇給。柏姸、凱文相約換上泳裝暢玩溫泉樂園，怎料衣著風格卻大不同？

programme.title: 東坡家事#5粵PG
programme.desc: 少游拜會東坡，東坡贈他錢糧卻被拒。大妹暗中取豬肉榮還給蘇家的錢作扇子店頂讓費，東窗事發，大妹揚言三日內交還……東坡以為蘇邁作弄閏之而責備他；蘇邁離家出走被街童欺負，幸少游出現制止，故對少游言聽計從……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#143粵
programme.desc: 婚紗店前僱主慫恿情接手她的店來創業，情答應，更向保險公司辭職。情向家人宣布此事，但眾人擔心有情受騙，更發現該舖位處於好位置。眾人商議的結果是由根、溢及義輪流在該舖位進行創業比賽，可是三人皆以慘蝕收場。

programme.title: 命轉皇后#18粵普PG
programme.desc: 張遮引黃潛、三娘子和馮明宇大打出手，並隨薛定非趁亂逃走。馮明宇欲引爆山上炸藥，看到謝危拉弓射向張遮，雪寧以身相護。薛遠聽到刀琴喊薛定非名字，派人暗中打探。雪寧請求張遮不要上報對謝危的懷疑，張遮應允。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 主持們化身「橋王之王」、「扭計師爺」、「烏利」後人，前往廣東新會博物館尋寶，蕭欣浩博士並講解多個「烏」字開首的俗語。果皮又稱陳皮，有何典故？以陳皮浸泡普洱茶，「茶三酒四」更有味道！男士們因對聯大打出手被叫「收皮」，粗俗說法源於「番攤」賭博？智堅、文軒「陸榮廷睇相」，專家施志明亦會講述江湖術士「搵丁」的歷史。火水哥重遇舊同學李佳芯，「零腐皮」女神竟向他示愛……他更英雄救美，讓二世祖「抽水抽着火水」！

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 新會洪聖始祖館暗藏「反清復明」，蕭博士解說館內的藏字詩。眾人還向蔡李佛拳後人學習「穿、撓、插」各種招式。「陳德貴」常在童謠歌詞中出現，到底何方神聖？<氹氹轉菊花園又為何有多個版本？「桄榔樹」火水哥意外中獎，獲彭慧中上門服侍24小時，網民得悉後即「有請小鳳姐」！二人的感情可會是「大笪地賣粥」？除了時、分、秒外，「一個骨」、「晏啲」亦用作表示時間，廖Sir細說箇中詞義；「過一牌」竟源於宋朝衙牌制度？

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普
手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 本節目將帶您走進亞洲文化的手工藝術世界，彰顯不同國家的美學。工匠們用心地透過藝術和耐心的加工，創造出了精工細作的文化遺產。工藝及其藝術表現形式作為傳統文化的遺產，為文化多樣性提供了豐富的內容。

programme.title: 海藻掌門人粵英
programme.desc: 海藻越來越受歡迎，其多樣性不斷給美食家帶來驚喜。無論它們是因為營養特性、碘化風味還是美觀而受到追捧，它們都注定會征服世界。我們將踏上一段旅程，追尋這些特殊海藻的足跡。

programme.title: 仨心友行 3粵
programme.desc: 花繩是懷舊玩意，穎鏇首次體驗那些年的趣味。「高手」佳芯為怕曝露年齡，欲隱藏實力？三女都曾擔任「是非精」，這次接受嘉賓黃子恆的戶外濾水考驗，竟越濾越深色……動腦筋後，眾人隨頌缽導師感受音療力量。藝人難以交朋友，眾人有何看法？女主持各自寫下三大好友名單，佳芯因拍劇與諾懿成為「家人」，穎鏇則與伍允龍結「兄妹緣」；美恩亦會分享和駱胤鳴、吳若希的友誼。四人分隊玩猜猜畫畫，輸家受罰，為何卻見美恩躺於子恆懷抱？

programme.title: 約埋班Friend遊香港粵
programme.desc: 浚霆帶隊，竟然去商場、返將軍澳？兩處同有驚喜，商場內也能打高爾夫、玩懷舊攤位遊戲；將軍澳則可在跨灣大橋踩單車，浚霆亦會訴說入行前被明星使喚之苦……阿滕另邊廂約同麥包，乘搭第六代的山頂纜車上山頂，還於藝術館內瘋狂打卡，望着維港靚景更趁機各自大讚另一半。齊人去Glamping，營內互選最mean、最麻煩之人，即管看看大家如何為自己的選擇打圓場。圍爐談及拍攝結緣節目《街市遊樂團》的起源，最初竟沒美儀份？

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 提到吉祥物，大家現時多會聯想到可愛的動物或公仔。谷主凱文指古代亦存在吉祥物，其作用主要是祈求平安、辟邪納福。她列舉蝙蝠、龜、鹿、鶴、蟠桃等皆是中國古代常見的吉祥物，西方則有貓、蛇等。現代吉祥物的起源可追溯至十九世紀的體育運動，其後逐漸發展至企業品牌、政府公益等領域，谷主們亦大讚TVBuddy、大嘥鬼等本地吉祥物的設計蘊含巧思。凱文又準備了2008年北京奧運的吉祥物資料，盛讚設計成功帶來了巨大收益。

programme.title: 開心大綜藝之暑假玩到盡粵PG
programme.desc: 主持Bob、區永權以遊戲為十一位藝人分隊，壓軸的蔚雨芯由隊長上演浮台對決爭奪，「康豪隊」憑郭子豪的勇猛表現搶人成功。從水上滑梯滑下再射龍門，看似容易，「控球」才是最難，「威潮隊」翟威廉更因莽撞行為被扣分！「日落西山下」玩法簡單，過程卻揭示游嘉欣的古怪思想，還見證波波太聰明，慘變豬隊友！轉戰陸上，全隊要排成直線，再跳過滾動的呼拉圈，黃美棋的身高竟成負累？玩盡多個回合，今集敗方要接受甚麼「火辣」懲罰？

programme.title: 尋找世界另一個我 台灣篇粵
programme.desc: 郭柏妍(Rosita)赴高雄與同名同姓之人「相認」，先聽聽其錄音，按形容畫下樣貌，再往火車站尋人。誰知另一位郭柏妍(Ann)已跟她擦身幾次！Ann帶Rosita到公園暢談讀書時代及家人周邊事，竟發現二人童年生活有很多近似點！Rosita來台灣前提出了兩個「夢想」，其一是進夜店。節目組要兩位柏妍為對方選購「戰衣」，登上夜店，她們連番「被嚇」？翌日，另一個同在高雄長大的郭柏妍(Betty)已在等候……

programme.title: 尋找世界另一個我 台灣篇粵
programme.desc: 玩過旋轉木馬，三位郭柏妍分享少女心事，Rosita稱讀書時沒拍拖是遺憾，其實她曾向心儀男生示愛？三人還在螢幕前談論可會接受婚前親密行為。Betty一直在高雄生活，夢想是「台中一日遊」，Rosita和Ann牽手相伴，為她圓夢。其中一站到Betty想考進的大學參觀，跟室內設計系主任先打個招呼。相處時光尾聲，兩位高雄柏妍細訴這趟旅程的感受，令Rosita不斷流淚，還要她閉起眼睛，以「熟悉」歌聲送上驚喜！

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵PG
programme.desc: 今年是人類充滿惶恐不安的一年，網絡上流傳不少大災難的預言：中東戰火、日本超級大地震等，我們的明天究竟會怎樣呢？很多人想預知未來，研究它的真假，在網絡資訊爆炸的時代，越講越真，越知道反而越驚，就好像聖經一早預言：『人想起將要臨到世界的事，就嚇得魂不附體』這一刻，站在文明懸崖上的我們，是否正要見證這古老預言成為現實？在全新一輯的地球大神秘，我們會繼續從世界各地神秘事件，探討各種預言的真確，還會同被稱為最準確重要的預言書《聖經》作對比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 魔神創造傳粵日
programme.desc: 御富良院希望助救世主一臂之力，但苦無魔神可用，一行人遇到龍神使者龍龍，在其帶領下抵達新區域，誰知馬上遇到炎上達手下之一的完蛋師傅，御富良院的額頭因他而大幅變長，連走路也走不穩。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 在運動中融入不同主題，能夠增添趣味，令孩子們更投入鍛練。本集的「WORKOUT 2GETHER」由Mandy姐姐帶領，首先透過聆聽敲擊樂器的指令，進行下肢肌力訓練，讓小朋友在互動遊戲中邊玩邊練。接着，她再將八爪魚、企鵝等海洋生物的動作融入全身肌力訓練。孩子們模仿不同海洋生物的姿態，既充滿趣味，又能提升身體協調能力。另外，「動物好萌友」環節會帶來大熊貓的有趣生活片段，並介紹牠們的生活習性與行為。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 安妮的童話粵日
programme.desc: 安妮與朋友玩「命令遊戲」，不慎從屋頂摔下跌斷腿骨，需要休養六星期。新來的教師史黛絲年輕貌美，教學方式生動，更提議舉辦聖誕節音樂會，獲得學生支持。安妮表演朗誦詩歌，令台下觀眾驚豔。

programme.title: 野性四季：珍稀野生動物在中國粵
programme.desc: 《野性四季：珍稀野生動物在中國》聯合世界頂尖野生動物拍攝團隊，透過以年為週期的野外追蹤拍攝，為動物國寶留存具有歷史意義和科學價值的珍貴影像檔案。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 北部都會區發展如火如荼，除了各個產業，政府指亦會發展鄉郊旅遊，包括撥款2億元推行先導計劃，推展鄉郊旅遊項目，及在新界北兩條鄉村試行，容許村屋全棟或部分樓層改裝為食肆或民宿，鄉郊旅遊的發展潛力有多大呢？現時已有不少鄉郊地方成為旅遊熱點，有村民認為對他們生活造成影響，未來要發展鄉郊旅遊，如何平衡各持份者的需要呢？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 渣打夥拍保誠攜手傳承：家傳之「保」2粵
programme.desc: 「洪家班」盛載三代傳承故事，洪天明偕妻積極推動電影武術，要將爸爸「大哥大」洪金寶的衣缽發揚光大。孫兒洪大仁早前與爺爺、父親一同參演微電影，也立志成為演員。天明駕車帶大哥大「遊車河」，回望昔日片場點滴，並感謝父親給予自由發展空間。爺孫關係同樣緊密，除了耍棍功夫，大仁亦獲爺爺親授家傳菜「金元寶」，用湯勺煎蛋皮卻惹笑料？大仁則以手工藝表心意，場面溫馨！同場加映洪家問答環節，大哥大秒答「兒孫二選一」題目？

programme.title: AlipayHK 呈獻：唱錢粵
programme.desc: All Stars版《唱錢》再臨，「聲夢隊」姚焯菲、詹天文、冼靖峰、何晉樂，與「聲秀隊」柯雨霏、甄敏芳、馮熙燮、胡子貝上演歌藝大激鬥。這集率先引爆「女女」戰火，藉輪流挑戰Sing盤上不同歌曲難度「搶分」，甚至是最難的Monster關卡。觀眾只需用手機掃描螢幕上的QR Code，即可參與直播室互動，為挑戰者打氣，更有機會贏取福利。

programme.title: 伯樂音樂學院20週年呈獻：J Music粵
programme.desc: 年輕女歌手黃健怡、陳苡臻、李晞彤合唱<對我有感覺後，互訴對拍檔的感覺。健怡新歌大膽地名為<媽媽的鋼管舞，實是讚揚母親的偉大？苡臻將手機比喻為<潘朵拉盒子，一旦伴侶查看就會「出事」？VIVA隊長晞彤推出第一首個人作品，要舊有規條<讓路？許文軒倒數「勁歌金榜」，本週有四首新歌上榜！文軒亦相約JW王灝兒暢談她成為獨立歌手後的三首作品。節目《魔音女團》其中四位女生，會翻唱Cookies的<眼淺。

programme.title: 風味人間 第2季粵
programme.desc: 在台灣澎湖，九月正值墨魚豐收季節，除了製成魚丸外，還可加豬肉，炮製成可口的墨魚香腸。德國人熱愛香腸，並衍生出逾四百款口味。巴伐利亞地區的慕尼黑白腸，雖然賞味期限短，仍吸引不少人看準時機前往品嚐。匈牙利的曼加利察豬是當地特有品種，將肉碎混合香料，再煙燻與風乾處理，成為當地家庭聚會上的必備美食。四川民眾將土豬肉切塊，混入花椒、紅辣椒調味，再手工灌腸。這至少經半個月燻烤的臘腸，是深受巴蜀人喜愛的老味道。

programme.title: J Sport粵
programme.desc: 港足中堅甘智健助傑志捧起港超錦標，也當選明星十一人與最佳青年球員，他如何看自身躍進？小車手余櫻嵐於全國青少年山地單車賽膺三連霸，她細訴箇中熱愛與點滴。空手道小將藍梴榗也有突破，在空手道青年聯賽分站打入決賽，感受怎樣？曾璧山(崇蘭)中學設草地滾球場，鼓勵體能程度不一的學生參與，同學們有甚麼得着？有本港馬球隊備戰亞洲盃，並暢談目標。另搜羅高級組銀牌籃球賽戰報、海岸賽艇環島大賽記招、立法會運動日的花絮。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
廉政狙擊#15粵PG
programme.desc: 曉山認為正鈿有意針對，掀起父女恩怨，子峰的開解讓她心動不已。寶群得知屠敏是子欣，前往相認，卻被拒絕。家晴也找屠敏相認，屠敏口硬心軟，被她的率真融化。家晴獨自往歌廳期間，遇上色魔意圖侵犯，陷入險境。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 約埋班Friend遊香港粵
programme.desc: 浚霆帶隊，竟然去商場、返將軍澳？兩處同有驚喜，商場內也能打高爾夫、玩懷舊攤位遊戲；將軍澳則可在跨灣大橋踩單車，浚霆亦會訴說入行前被明星使喚之苦……阿滕另邊廂約同麥包，乘搭第六代的山頂纜車上山頂，還於藝術館內瘋狂打卡，望着維港靚景更趁機各自大讚另一半。齊人去Glamping，營內互選最mean、最麻煩之人，即管看看大家如何為自己的選擇打圓場。圍爐談及拍攝結緣節目《街市遊樂團》的起源，最初竟沒美儀份？

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 提到吉祥物，大家現時多會聯想到可愛的動物或公仔。谷主凱文指古代亦存在吉祥物，其作用主要是祈求平安、辟邪納福。她列舉蝙蝠、龜、鹿、鶴、蟠桃等皆是中國古代常見的吉祥物，西方則有貓、蛇等。現代吉祥物的起源可追溯至十九世紀的體育運動，其後逐漸發展至企業品牌、政府公益等領域，谷主們亦大讚TVBuddy、大嘥鬼等本地吉祥物的設計蘊含巧思。凱文又準備了2008年北京奧運的吉祥物資料，盛讚設計成功帶來了巨大收益。

programme.title: 仨心友行 3粵
programme.desc: 花繩是懷舊玩意，穎鏇首次體驗那些年的趣味。「高手」佳芯為怕曝露年齡，欲隱藏實力？三女都曾擔任「是非精」，這次接受嘉賓黃子恆的戶外濾水考驗，竟越濾越深色……動腦筋後，眾人隨頌缽導師感受音療力量。藝人難以交朋友，眾人有何看法？女主持各自寫下三大好友名單，佳芯因拍劇與諾懿成為「家人」，穎鏇則與伍允龍結「兄妹緣」；美恩亦會分享和駱胤鳴、吳若希的友誼。四人分隊玩猜猜畫畫，輸家受罰，為何卻見美恩躺於子恆懷抱？

programme.title: 尋找世界另一個我 台灣篇粵
programme.desc: 郭柏妍(Rosita)赴高雄與同名同姓之人「相認」，先聽聽其錄音，按形容畫下樣貌，再往火車站尋人。誰知另一位郭柏妍(Ann)已跟她擦身幾次！Ann帶Rosita到公園暢談讀書時代及家人周邊事，竟發現二人童年生活有很多近似點！Rosita來台灣前提出了兩個「夢想」，其一是進夜店。節目組要兩位柏妍為對方選購「戰衣」，登上夜店，她們連番「被嚇」？翌日，另一個同在高雄長大的郭柏妍(Betty)已在等候……

programme.title: 尋找世界另一個我 台灣篇粵
programme.desc: 玩過旋轉木馬，三位郭柏妍分享少女心事，Rosita稱讀書時沒拍拖是遺憾，其實她曾向心儀男生示愛？三人還在螢幕前談論可會接受婚前親密行為。Betty一直在高雄生活，夢想是「台中一日遊」，Rosita和Ann牽手相伴，為她圓夢。其中一站到Betty想考進的大學參觀，跟室內設計系主任先打個招呼。相處時光尾聲，兩位高雄柏妍細訴這趟旅程的感受，令Rosita不斷流淚，還要她閉起眼睛，以「熟悉」歌聲送上驚喜！

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 本節目將帶您走進亞洲文化的手工藝術世界，彰顯不同國家的美學。工匠們用心地透過藝術和耐心的加工，創造出了精工細作的文化遺產。工藝及其藝術表現形式作為傳統文化的遺產，為文化多樣性提供了豐富的內容。

programme.title: 海藻掌門人粵英
programme.desc: 海藻越來越受歡迎，其多樣性不斷給美食家帶來驚喜。無論它們是因為營養特性、碘化風味還是美觀而受到追捧，它們都注定會征服世界。我們將踏上一段旅程，追尋這些特殊海藻的足跡。

programme.title: 隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普
粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 主持們化身「橋王之王」、「扭計師爺」、「烏利」後人，前往廣東新會博物館尋寶，蕭欣浩博士並講解多個「烏」字開首的俗語。果皮又稱陳皮，有何典故？以陳皮浸泡普洱茶，「茶三酒四」更有味道！男士們因對聯大打出手被叫「收皮」，粗俗說法源於「番攤」賭博？智堅、文軒「陸榮廷睇相」，專家施志明亦會講述江湖術士「搵丁」的歷史。火水哥重遇舊同學李佳芯，「零腐皮」女神竟向他示愛……他更英雄救美，讓二世祖「抽水抽着火水」！

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 新會洪聖始祖館暗藏「反清復明」，蕭博士解說館內的藏字詩。眾人還向蔡李佛拳後人學習「穿、撓、插」各種招式。「陳德貴」常在童謠歌詞中出現，到底何方神聖？<氹氹轉菊花園又為何有多個版本？「桄榔樹」火水哥意外中獎，獲彭慧中上門服侍24小時，網民得悉後即「有請小鳳姐」！二人的感情可會是「大笪地賣粥」？除了時、分、秒外，「一個骨」、「晏啲」亦用作表示時間，廖Sir細說箇中詞義；「過一牌」竟源於宋朝衙牌制度？

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 黎諾懿、阮小儀應邀接受Do姐出題挑戰。體驗韓國濟州文化，「識住梗係住民宿」！「問題專員」帶大家見識既傳統又現代化的韓屋，每所韓屋門前均設置了三根木，各種擺放方式還有不同意思？泰國人洗車時都不會抹走車身的神秘圖案，兩隊對箇中原因信心十足，紛紛使用雙倍錦囊，結果如何？日本某壽司師傅刀法細膩，更身懷令人「O嘴」的驚世絕技？來到刺激的兌換貨幣環節，有嘉賓輸得慘烈，竟高呼「唔鬼嚟」！

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: Do姐向嘉賓田蕊妮、吳業坤、拍檔農夫分享旅遊小知識。在印尼峇里，向人伸出小指原來有特別意思，Do姐還當面以此招呼農夫！看片答問題，曼谷一家醫院有特別方法提升工作效率；阿田口快說出「答案」讓坤哥「抄考」！Do姐請來大廚即席烹調菜式，原來要嘉賓猜出當中食材。坤哥使用「貼士錦囊」，還大方向阿田公開！用積分兌換獎金之前，「問題專員」鄺潔楹帶大家到東京的展覽館參觀，但展廳內不見任何藝術品，究竟怎麼一回事？

programme.title: 文明啟航粵英
programme.desc: 一連六集，歷史學家Bettany Hughes將帶領觀眾踏上另一段令人難忘的人類文明史之旅。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 未來生日的7月12日即將到來，在未來提議下，大家將會到未來家一起製作生日蛋糕。另一方面，繪萌為了贈送一份與眾不同的生日禮物，打算靠自己製作蛋糕，更找上擅長烹飪的小鈴哥哥優介，學習蛋糕的製法。

programme.title: 喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險粵普
programme.desc: 未來的小羊們獲得了灰太狼新制的發明“變小手錶”，變成迷你版小羊並坐上慢羊羊發明的玩具小車，前往微觀世界，幫助大家解決各式各樣的問題。

programme.title: 喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險粵普
programme.desc: 未來的小羊們獲得了灰太狼新制的發明“變小手錶”，變成迷你版小羊並坐上慢羊羊發明的玩具小車，前往微觀世界，幫助大家解決各式各樣的問題。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 大雄弄髒了胖虎借他的書，不知該如何告訴他，多啦A夢於是借他「反應試驗機械人」進行測試。亞剛國王訪日，意外之下讓大雄吃了「盛情款待梨」，大雄於是請對方到家裡作客，令多啦A夢慌張不已。

programme.title: LET'S CAMP! 露營少女粵日
programme.desc: 凜前往精進糊單獨露營，其間憶起外公第一次帶自己去露營的種種，並期望再次偕同撫子去露營。千明、葵與撫子嘗試自製酒精爐，並計劃下次去惠那家裡的花園露營，同時剪頭髮和用酒精爐燒烤。

programme.title: 嫁到這世界邊端粵
programme.desc: 德國暖男Markus在港認識香港女生卡菲，二人拍拖不久男方便要回國，卡菲毅然決定嫁到德國，入住一個絕少華人居住的小城明斯特，拋棄香港一切，不懂德語的她如何從零重新開始？因語言障礙，卡菲身邊只有丈夫可分憂，即使母親開口歡迎她隨時回港，她都堅持留下，皆因一個理念！卡菲直言不懂撒嬌，亦不想在港做剩女，於是賭一回做過埠新娘。從Markus對卡菲的窩心舉動及充滿愛的眼神，陳貝兒直言羨慕不已！

programme.title: 煮戰粵
programme.desc: 西廚Ken上集於雞蛋熱身賽力壓中廚Alan，穩袋十分。第二回合，Alan以「香煎琵琶蝦伴地芝八寶餃」，迎擊Ken施展的「法術三度半」。Alan巧妙加入西式技法，將冬瓜盅變成「粉紅仙氣餃」，既清新又消暑。香煎琵琶蝦配濃郁蟹粉，鮮味加倍昇華！Ken為龍蝦啫喱球注入番茄凍湯、熱湯，變奏出不同滋味。龍蝦汁雪耳、韭菜田雞肉、藍莓芝士「願望瓶」等料理，驚喜不斷！兩位煮將完美展現對烹飪的極致追求，終極冠軍誰屬？

programme.title: 教煮爭霸粵
programme.desc: 曹永廉穿針引線下，「鼎爺」李家鼎、「三姐」蕭秀香兩位烹飪高手碰頭，啟動連場比拼！就着中秋團圓菜的主題，三姐帶來「鳳凰抱月」，將鮮鮑魚、芋頭等十多種食材製成餡料釀進雞內。過程中縱現穿皮意外，但無損賣相，再加「月亮」點綴，非常應景。鼎爺則構思出功夫菜「鳳舞九天慶團圓」，巧用花膠作雲吞皮，配上鹹肉、金華火腿，還以菱角熬製鮮雞湯，用料十足。經過嘉賓馬海倫及兩位識食評判的盲試品評，哪位「教煮」能夠先拔頭籌？

programme.title: 積金講e啲粵
programme.desc: 強積金是僱員退休後的保障之一，跟全港打工仔女息息相關。《積金講e啲》由藝員梁敏巧、吳幸美、曾展望、徐榮、鄧凱文、曾錦燊、吳香倫參與演出，以輕鬆手法向強積金計劃的持分者，介紹當局網上平台「積金易」等與強積金相關的實用資訊及注意事項。

programme.title: 初入職場·中醫季粵普
programme.desc: 《初入職場·中醫季》深度聚焦中醫文化，攜手中醫專業人才及中醫助力團一起，通過"潮養生活"與"中醫歷練"，開啟一場年輕態的中醫文化科普之旅。

programme.title: 澳洲潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 短尾矮袋鼠紅爆動物界，梁芷珮抵達西澳珀斯，即往羅特尼斯島見識「最萌動物」的魅力。為拍到完美合照，她不顧滿地便便，瞓身自拍！遊船河享用海鮮大餐，最期待是即撈即煮新鮮龍蝦，但原來某些龍蝦要放回大海？玩水後上高空，芷珮迎來人生第一次高空跳傘。從機艙躍出，西澳海岸線、島上美景盡入眼簾，恐懼一掃而空！下榻島上營地，感受大自然氣息，好寫意！接着隨農場主人採摘食材，體會Farm To Table的健康飲食理念。

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 香港貴為國際美食天堂，各式各樣甜品包羅萬有，其中以造型精美、形象百變的西式甜品，最能贏得年輕人歡心。甜品誕生過程引人入勝，製作趣味無窮。節目請來甜品界享譽盛名、獲獎無數的「朱古力魔法師」古嘉俊（阿古）擔任主持，聯同藝人嘉賓李施嬅、高海寧、湯洛雯、黃智雯、譚嘉儀、賴慰玲、呂慧儀、陳敏之、羅孝勇、林欣彤、劉溫馨、黃心穎，一起發揮豐富創意，運用各種意想不到的食材配搭，為觀眾變出源源不絕的甜美驚喜。

programme.title: 魔神創造傳粵日
programme.desc: 御富良院懷疑瑪蘿是炎上達派來的間諜，拉上阿渡展開調查行動卻一無所穫，此時他們遇到増行暴露宇，對方自稱是週刊記者，揚言要大爆瑪蘿的秘密，直至受害村民找上門，始揭發他才是炎上達手下。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 女生獨自登上「My Little Show」舞台，淡定彈奏古典樂曲，琴音悠揚而動人。另有四位少女穿上閃耀舞衣登場，伴隨節拍音樂，舞動身體，更會展示側手翻、一字馬等高難度動作，活力十足！有朋友相伴一起成長，可讓人生更豐富、精彩。這回，結他導師彈出<Shining Friends和<當你靠着我，引領玲玲姐姐與Tiffany姐姐一起歌頌「友你同行」。此外，她們還會分享與好友攜手合作、奮鬥的日子。

programme.title: 屁屁偵探粵日
programme.desc: 改編自人氣繪本。各位小朋友快跟著無人不知的名偵探屁屁偵探全面出擊，透過細心觀察及推理，偵破各類案件吧！

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 姐姐因為經常要忍讓妹妹小丸子，所以感到有點委屈。並且由於羨慕小丸子可向人撒嬌，而產生了希望有個姐姐的想法。梅雨季節，小丸子將會和爺爺去觀賞繡球花。為此，小丸子嘗試想一些不會被雨淋濕的方法。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 財經透視粵
programme.desc: 非本地學生宿位供不應求的問題嚴重，越來越多投資者把手上的出租物業，轉型做學生宿舍，情況如何？不少人都有外遊前買旅遊保險的習慣，但魔鬼在細節裡，買旅遊保險時要注意甚麼？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
星期日檔案粵
programme.desc: 在科技發達的時代，玩具漸漸被智能產品取代。不過，近年陀螺及卡牌遊戲的再度興起，不論是成年人或小孩都受到吸引，引起了一波「玩具狂熱」。有人用玩具重拾童年回憶，亦有人用玩具建立人際關係，這波「玩具狂熱」能否可以打破現今人與人之間的隔幕？

programme.title: 積金講e啲粵
programme.desc: 強積金是僱員退休後的保障之一，跟全港打工仔女息息相關。《積金講e啲》由藝員梁敏巧、吳幸美、曾展望、徐榮、鄧凱文、曾錦燊、吳香倫參與演出，以輕鬆手法向強積金計劃的持分者，介紹當局網上平台「積金易」等與強積金相關的實用資訊及注意事項。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 保濟丸130 週年呈獻：中年好聲音4粵
programme.desc: 《中年好聲音4》迎來累積排名分之戰，十強選手將上演五個回合的主題歌曲比拼，累積分數最低的三人，會被淘汰。最終七強登上啟德體藝館終極決賽舞台，以爭奪冠軍殊榮！累積排名第一戰以「K歌之夜」作主題，歌手關心妍應邀擔任嘉賓評審，並負責選出這集MVP，而MVP將額外獲得2分加持。好拍檔曾航生、何婉盈坐上「知音人」的頭等席；現場還特意佈置成K房模樣，節目組更把參賽歌精心製作成特別版MV，伴隨各人演繹其間播放。

programme.title: 神燈娛樂呈獻：一周星星粵
programme.desc: 許志安於好友間被笑稱「老鼠安」，安仔卻指早於中學時已有此花名，且是一種讚美？音樂人雷頌德指安仔錄音時能夠「自帶濾鏡」，他寫的哪首作品最得安仔喜歡？和胡杏兒合演《肥田囍事》，安仔曾做錯一件事？主持翻出舊片段，原來安仔曾說錯車婉婉名字！與好友張衛健一同拍劇《我愛牙擦蘇》，期間的關係反而變得疏離？Fact Check安仔可有珍藏衣物，參加「新秀」面試的上衣就儲了多年，但講起某條「白色」泳褲，已不願多提！

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 「燦神」廖偉雄在吉隆坡經營「人氣」食店，陳國強師傅帶暉哥前往品嚐招牌西刀魚蛋麵及玻璃叉燒，滋味如何？施焯日帶葉靖儀造訪謝霆鋒愛店，試吃霆鋒喜愛的美食：酥脆炸魚皮，牛味濃郁、麵質彈牙的崩沙腩撈粗麵。美食KOL Arthur推介老字號潮州菜館，招牌滷水鵝片拼盤、沙嗲牛肉炒河粉，皆是必吃之選。胡美貽駕車載廖慧儀前往鯉魚門，到坐擁無敵海景的酒家品嚐豉椒醬炒蟶子配煎米粉、秘製豉油皇大蝦等佳餚，鮮味十足。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
廉政狙擊#16粵PG
programme.desc: 家晴被侵犯後仍對以凡痴心一片，但遭以凡冷對待。曉山不滿子峰偏袒她父親，但子峰衝口而出向她表示好感，曉山便怒氣盡消。以凡發現車內有偷聽器，直接找廷光對質。繼明調查警隊高層與廷光勾結，助廷光洗脫殺人嫌疑。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 初入職場·中醫季粵普
programme.desc: 《初入職場·中醫季》深度聚焦中醫文化，攜手中醫專業人才及中醫助力團一起，通過"潮養生活"與"中醫歷練"，開啟一場年輕態的中醫文化科普之旅。

programme.title: 澳洲潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 短尾矮袋鼠紅爆動物界，梁芷珮抵達西澳珀斯，即往羅特尼斯島見識「最萌動物」的魅力。為拍到完美合照，她不顧滿地便便，瞓身自拍！遊船河享用海鮮大餐，最期待是即撈即煮新鮮龍蝦，但原來某些龍蝦要放回大海？玩水後上高空，芷珮迎來人生第一次高空跳傘。從機艙躍出，西澳海岸線、島上美景盡入眼簾，恐懼一掃而空！下榻島上營地，感受大自然氣息，好寫意！接着隨農場主人採摘食材，體會Farm To Table的健康飲食理念。

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 香港貴為國際美食天堂，各式各樣甜品包羅萬有，其中以造型精美、形象百變的西式甜品，最能贏得年輕人歡心。甜品誕生過程引人入勝，製作趣味無窮。節目請來甜品界享譽盛名、獲獎無數的「朱古力魔法師」古嘉俊（阿古）擔任主持，聯同藝人嘉賓李施嬅、高海寧、湯洛雯、黃智雯、譚嘉儀、賴慰玲、呂慧儀、陳敏之、羅孝勇、林欣彤、劉溫馨、黃心穎，一起發揮豐富創意，運用各種意想不到的食材配搭，為觀眾變出源源不絕的甜美驚喜。

programme.title: 嫁到這世界邊端粵
programme.desc: 德國暖男Markus在港認識香港女生卡菲，二人拍拖不久男方便要回國，卡菲毅然決定嫁到德國，入住一個絕少華人居住的小城明斯特，拋棄香港一切，不懂德語的她如何從零重新開始？因語言障礙，卡菲身邊只有丈夫可分憂，即使母親開口歡迎她隨時回港，她都堅持留下，皆因一個理念！卡菲直言不懂撒嬌，亦不想在港做剩女，於是賭一回做過埠新娘。從Markus對卡菲的窩心舉動及充滿愛的眼神，陳貝兒直言羨慕不已！

programme.title: 煮戰粵
programme.desc: 西廚Ken上集於雞蛋熱身賽力壓中廚Alan，穩袋十分。第二回合，Alan以「香煎琵琶蝦伴地芝八寶餃」，迎擊Ken施展的「法術三度半」。Alan巧妙加入西式技法，將冬瓜盅變成「粉紅仙氣餃」，既清新又消暑。香煎琵琶蝦配濃郁蟹粉，鮮味加倍昇華！Ken為龍蝦啫喱球注入番茄凍湯、熱湯，變奏出不同滋味。龍蝦汁雪耳、韭菜田雞肉、藍莓芝士「願望瓶」等料理，驚喜不斷！兩位煮將完美展現對烹飪的極致追求，終極冠軍誰屬？

programme.title: 教煮爭霸粵
programme.desc: 曹永廉穿針引線下，「鼎爺」李家鼎、「三姐」蕭秀香兩位烹飪高手碰頭，啟動連場比拼！就着中秋團圓菜的主題，三姐帶來「鳳凰抱月」，將鮮鮑魚、芋頭等十多種食材製成餡料釀進雞內。過程中縱現穿皮意外，但無損賣相，再加「月亮」點綴，非常應景。鼎爺則構思出功夫菜「鳳舞九天慶團圓」，巧用花膠作雲吞皮，配上鹹肉、金華火腿，還以菱角熬製鮮雞湯，用料十足。經過嘉賓馬海倫及兩位識食評判的盲試品評，哪位「教煮」能夠先拔頭籌？

programme.title: 文明啟航粵英
programme.desc: 一連六集，歷史學家Bettany Hughes將帶領觀眾踏上另一段令人難忘的人類文明史之旅。

programme.title: CI alk 國際直球對決(首)
CI alk 國際直球對決(首)
呱張爆音團
programme.desc: 12歲的柯阿瑞和他的三個好朋友一起在車庫裡成立了一支樂隊，但是很快的他們就發現他們的樂隊很爛-真的很爛。問題不在他們的音樂或是百變造型，而是因為柯阿瑞寫不出歌詞。他就是想不出酷炫的歌詞嘛，直到......柯阿瑞找到了他姊姊翠娜的日記。「哇！這裡面不只廢話連篇，還有滿滿的青少年煩惱。」柯阿瑞和樂隊「秘密的」用翠娜最新的日記作為他們的創作新曲的歌詞–結果你知道怎麼樣嗎？效果真是棒到要大叫嗷嗷嗷，當然演出機會也越來越多了！這樣一來就皆大歡喜了，對嗎？才怪。翠娜是個超級討人厭的恰查某，完全無法忍受她弟弟的爛樂隊比她還要紅。她想盡辦法要來粉碎他們的夢想。但沒關係啦。柯阿瑞很瞭解他姊姊，嗯...就像姊姊肚子裡的蛔蟲一樣。柯阿瑞總是知道該怎麼做才能讓翠娜炸毛，然後生出他們最欠缺的東西......歌詞！快跟著柯阿瑞和他的樂團嗨翻天吧！看他們為達目的怎麼不擇手段的惡搞翠娜的玻璃心世界吧！

programme.title: 搗蛋拉茶鋪
programme.desc: 熱愛拉茶的老闆，和自信滿滿的服務生狗狗，在飄著香氣的拉茶鋪裡享受著愜意的時光。然而一切平靜，都被一隻搗蛋的猴子破壞了！為了趕走猴子，狗狗與猴子的戰鬥即將展開！

programme.title: 呱張爆音團
programme.desc: 12歲的柯阿瑞和他的三個好朋友一起在車庫裡成立了一支樂隊，但是很快的他們就發現他們的樂隊很爛-真的很爛。問題不在他們的音樂或是百變造型，而是因為柯阿瑞寫不出歌詞。他就是想不出酷炫的歌詞嘛，直到......柯阿瑞找到了他姊姊翠娜的日記。「哇！這裡面不只廢話連篇，還有滿滿的青少年煩惱。」柯阿瑞和樂隊「秘密的」用翠娜最新的日記作為他們的創作新曲的歌詞–結果你知道怎麼樣嗎？效果真是棒到要大叫嗷嗷嗷，當然演出機會也越來越多了！這樣一來就皆大歡喜了，對嗎？才怪。翠娜是個超級討人厭的恰查某，完全無法忍受她弟弟的爛樂隊比她還要紅。她想盡辦法要來粉碎他們的夢想。但沒關係啦。柯阿瑞很瞭解他姊姊，嗯...就像姊姊肚子裡的蛔蟲一樣。柯阿瑞總是知道該怎麼做才能讓翠娜炸毛，然後生出他們最欠缺的東西......歌詞！快跟著柯阿瑞和他的樂團嗨翻天吧！看他們為達目的怎麼不擇手段的惡搞翠娜的玻璃心世界吧！

programme.desc: 【朴恩惠經典復仇之作好閨密為渣男反目成仇】因做錯抉擇導致人生本末倒置的女人，經過4次婚姻終於找到真愛與幸福的故事。柳佳恩把初戀情人當成全部，放棄了自己的夢想，卻得到徹頭徹尾的背叛。她的第一任丈夫朴正宇，圖謀佳恩家的財富和地位與佳恩結婚，在達到目的後將佳恩拋棄，轉而和情人美蘭結婚，陰謀奪得了佳恩父親的公司，並間接害死了佳恩的父親。在如此深仇大恨面前，佳恩一步步從一位百合般純潔的女人，變成了帶刺的玫瑰。

programme.title: 逆轉女王
programme.desc: 【經典韓劇《賢內助女王》姊妹作】黃泰熙原是高薪的開發組長，但為了追求幸福家庭，她選擇與新同事奉俊秀結婚。然而她的決定，卻讓她被信任的女上司趕出公司，只能在家當賢內助。五年後，泰熙感到現實生活的沉重，決定重返職場。在公司她遇見了具勇植，一位支持她的本部長。泰熙在勇植的鼓勵下展現出更堅韌的一面，最終成功東山再起，找到了新的事業目標。

programme.title: 真愛OnAir
programme.desc: 【金荷娜《Onair》詮釋辛辣女星與編劇、導演、經紀人上演修羅場！】傲氣女星吳升雅外冷內熱，渴望被理解；毒舌編劇徐英恩辛辣犀利，因背叛築起心牆；導演李慶民冷面苛刻，與英恩有難解過往；經紀人張基俊圓融細膩，總在混亂中守住分寸。四人因同一部劇合作，從爭執、碰撞、試探，到逐漸看見彼此的脆弱與真心。升雅卸下武裝、英恩學會柔軟、慶民面對情感、基俊守住信念。他們不只拍戲，更在現場演繹真實人生。

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 名人初乃玩
programme.desc: 最接地氣的外景行腳節目,由名人帶領網路紅人到店家體驗吃、喝、玩、樂。寓教於樂，帶給觀眾耳目一新的超強體驗。

programme.title: 向風而行
programme.desc: 【《請叫我總監》譚松韻與《清平樂》王凱，飛向天際攜手築夢！！】鷺洲航空客運飛行部副部長顧南亭因公司改制，與性格颯爽不羈的程霄成為上下屬和師徒關係。面對接踵而來的突發航空事件，追求穩定秩序的顧南亭時常被不按常理出牌的程霄打亂計劃，共同經歷衝擊與考驗，一路披荊斬棘、相扶成長。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 步步驚心
programme.desc: 那一天，張曉的命運被一場車禍徹底改寫。她眼看著那輛失控的卡車將自己的靈魂撞出了軀體，而她，既沒有進醫院也沒有進天堂，卻是被撞進了清朝的宮廷中。就像鋪天蓋地的穿越小說裏寫的那樣，張曉的靈魂跨過時間的隧道，在一個叫馬爾泰.若曦的十六歲清朝女孩的體內，重生了…時年，康熙第四十三。天下太平，但一場震動歷史的「九龍奪嫡」正在暗潮湧動。權利的廝殺，愛情的灼燒，在被無限放大的歷史舞臺上，張曉，不，是馬爾泰•若曦的命運無可避免的與眾位親王阿哥們交織在一起…她知道自己不該捲入這場九王奪嫡的爭鬥中，可心不由己，因為這裡有她所愛的，也有愛著她的…若曦最後選擇的究竟是溫潤如玉的八阿哥，還是面冷心熱的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人?等歷史的風雲過後，可以陪她看夕陽西下、雲捲雲舒的又將是誰？

programme.title: 聖水洞之吻
programme.desc: 【年下實習生朴所羅門戀年上工作狂金智恩，吻出姊弟戀化學效應！！】業界能力頂級的行銷組組長姜娜恩，雖是個性冷血的工作狂，但能交出亮眼的工作成績單。遇上公司內MZ世代又期待戀愛的實習生蘇恩浩，兩人上年下的相處，因年齡及價值觀不同互相嫌棄。卻因意外接吻捲入「靈魂交換」事件。之後兩人會發生什麼有趣的事呢?

programme.title: 雙軌
programme.desc: 【何與×虞書欣偽骨科繼兄妹禁忌愛戀，從愛妹到曖昧火花四射！！】姜暮9歲前是被家人寵在手心的小女孩，靳朝是天之驕子的哥哥。那年父母離婚，兩人命運自此走上雙軌，爸爸和哥哥移居泰國，成為地下賽車與拳場中的修車工。多年後，19歲的姜暮得知哥哥是被領養的秘密，瞞著所有人獨自飛往泰國。在泰國的租屋中兩人展開了一段隱秘而甜蜜的情感旅程，在光明與黑暗間重逢，禁忌拉扯中雙向救贖。

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【改編人氣美國影集，張東健×朴炯植聯手成為法律界黃金拍檔！！】頭腦聰明，擁有過目不忘天才能力的高延宇，卻因家境關係卻步成為律師。混進了律師事務所遇上韓國頂級資深律師崔江錫。隨著事件發生與時間相處成為黃金拍檔，崔江錫要如何亦師亦友的帶著沒有正式唸過大學也只是菜鳥律師的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 呱張爆音團
programme.desc: 12歲的柯阿瑞和他的三個好朋友一起在車庫裡成立了一支樂隊，但是很快的他們就發現他們的樂隊很爛-真的很爛。問題不在他們的音樂或是百變造型，而是因為柯阿瑞寫不出歌詞。他就是想不出酷炫的歌詞嘛，直到......柯阿瑞找到了他姊姊翠娜的日記。「哇！這裡面不只廢話連篇，還有滿滿的青少年煩惱。」柯阿瑞和樂隊「秘密的」用翠娜最新的日記作為他們的創作新曲的歌詞–結果你知道怎麼樣嗎？效果真是棒到要大叫嗷嗷嗷，當然演出機會也越來越多了！這樣一來就皆大歡喜了，對嗎？才怪。翠娜是個超級討人厭的恰查某，完全無法忍受她弟弟的爛樂隊比她還要紅。她想盡辦法要來粉碎他們的夢想。但沒關係啦。柯阿瑞很瞭解他姊姊，嗯...就像姊姊肚子裡的蛔蟲一樣。柯阿瑞總是知道該怎麼做才能讓翠娜炸毛，然後生出他們最欠缺的東西......歌詞！快跟著柯阿瑞和他的樂團嗨翻天吧！看他們為達目的怎麼不擇手段的惡搞翠娜的玻璃心世界吧！

programme.title: 呱張爆音團
programme.desc: 12歲的柯阿瑞和他的三個好朋友一起在車庫裡成立了一支樂隊，但是很快的他們就發現他們的樂隊很爛-真的很爛。問題不在他們的音樂或是百變造型，而是因為柯阿瑞寫不出歌詞。他就是想不出酷炫的歌詞嘛，直到......柯阿瑞找到了他姊姊翠娜的日記。「哇！這裡面不只廢話連篇，還有滿滿的青少年煩惱。」柯阿瑞和樂隊「秘密的」用翠娜最新的日記作為他們的創作新曲的歌詞–結果你知道怎麼樣嗎？效果真是棒到要大叫嗷嗷嗷，當然演出機會也越來越多了！這樣一來就皆大歡喜了，對嗎？才怪。翠娜是個超級討人厭的恰查某，完全無法忍受她弟弟的爛樂隊比她還要紅。她想盡辦法要來粉碎他們的夢想。但沒關係啦。柯阿瑞很瞭解他姊姊，嗯...就像姊姊肚子裡的蛔蟲一樣。柯阿瑞總是知道該怎麼做才能讓翠娜炸毛，然後生出他們最欠缺的東西......歌詞！快跟著柯阿瑞和他的樂團嗨翻天吧！看他們為達目的怎麼不擇手段的惡搞翠娜的玻璃心世界吧！

programme.desc: 12歲的柯阿瑞和他的三個好朋友一起在車庫裡成立了一支樂隊，但是很快的他們就發現他們的樂隊很爛-真的很爛。問題不在他們的音樂或是百變造型，而是因為柯阿瑞寫不出歌詞。他就是想不出酷炫的歌詞嘛，直到......柯阿瑞找到了他姊姊翠娜的日記。「哇！這裡面不只廢話連篇，還有滿滿的青少年煩惱。」柯阿瑞和樂隊「秘密的」用翠娜最新的日記作為他們的創作新曲的歌詞–結果你知道怎麼樣嗎？效果真是棒到要大叫嗷嗷嗷，當然演出機會也越來越多了！這樣一來就皆大歡喜了，對嗎？才怪。翠娜是個超級討人厭的恰查某，完全無法忍受她弟弟的爛樂隊比她還要紅。她想盡辦法要來粉碎他們的夢想。但沒關係啦。柯阿瑞很瞭解他姊姊，嗯...就像姊姊肚子裡的蛔蟲一樣。柯阿瑞總是知道該怎麼做才能讓翠娜炸毛，然後生出他們最欠缺的東西......歌詞！快跟著柯阿瑞和他的樂團嗨翻天吧！看他們為達目的怎麼不擇手段的惡搞翠娜的玻璃心世界吧！

programme.title: 搗蛋拉茶鋪
programme.desc: 熱愛拉茶的老闆，和自信滿滿的服務生狗狗，在飄著香氣的拉茶鋪裡享受著愜意的時光。然而一切平靜，都被一隻搗蛋的猴子破壞了！為了趕走猴子，狗狗與猴子的戰鬥即將展開！

programme.title: 搗蛋拉茶鋪
programme.desc: 熱愛拉茶的老闆，和自信滿滿的服務生狗狗，在飄著香氣的拉茶鋪裡享受著愜意的時光。然而一切平靜，都被一隻搗蛋的猴子破壞了！為了趕走猴子，狗狗與猴子的戰鬥即將展開！

programme.title: 泡泡灣大冒險
programme.desc: 希希是一艘充滿勇氣的小帆船，夢想有一天能去探索廣大神秘的藍色海洋，但在那之前，要學的還有很多！看他如何運用智慧和工具箱，和夥伴們一起完成泡泡灣各式各樣的任務吧！

programme.title: 粉紅色口紅
programme.desc: 【朴恩惠經典復仇之作好閨密為渣男反目成仇】因做錯抉擇導致人生本末倒置的女人，經過4次婚姻終於找到真愛與幸福的故事。柳佳恩把初戀情人當成全部，放棄了自己的夢想，卻得到徹頭徹尾的背叛。她的第一任丈夫朴正宇，圖謀佳恩家的財富和地位與佳恩結婚，在達到目的後將佳恩拋棄，轉而和情人美蘭結婚，陰謀奪得了佳恩父親的公司，並間接害死了佳恩的父親。在如此深仇大恨面前，佳恩一步步從一位百合般純潔的女人，變成了帶刺的玫瑰。

programme.title: 逆轉女王
programme.desc: 【經典韓劇《賢內助女王》姊妹作】黃泰熙原是高薪的開發組長，但為了追求幸福家庭，她選擇與新同事奉俊秀結婚。然而她的決定，卻讓她被信任的女上司趕出公司，只能在家當賢內助。五年後，泰熙感到現實生活的沉重，決定重返職場。在公司她遇見了具勇植，一位支持她的本部長。泰熙在勇植的鼓勵下展現出更堅韌的一面，最終成功東山再起，找到了新的事業目標。

programme.title: 真愛OnAir
programme.desc: 【金荷娜《Onair》詮釋辛辣女星與編劇、導演、經紀人上演修羅場！】傲氣女星吳升雅外冷內熱，渴望被理解；毒舌編劇徐英恩辛辣犀利，因背叛築起心牆；導演李慶民冷面苛刻，與英恩有難解過往；經紀人張基俊圓融細膩，總在混亂中守住分寸。四人因同一部劇合作，從爭執、碰撞、試探，到逐漸看見彼此的脆弱與真心。升雅卸下武裝、英恩學會柔軟、慶民面對情感、基俊守住信念。他們不只拍戲，更在現場演繹真實人生。

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 名人初乃玩
programme.desc: 最接地氣的外景行腳節目,由名人帶領網路紅人到店家體驗吃、喝、玩、樂。寓教於樂，帶給觀眾耳目一新的超強體驗。

programme.title: 向風而行
programme.desc: 【《請叫我總監》譚松韻與《清平樂》王凱，飛向天際攜手築夢！！】鷺洲航空客運飛行部副部長顧南亭因公司改制，與性格颯爽不羈的程霄成為上下屬和師徒關係。面對接踵而來的突發航空事件，追求穩定秩序的顧南亭時常被不按常理出牌的程霄打亂計劃，共同經歷衝擊與考驗，一路披荊斬棘、相扶成長。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 步步驚心
programme.desc: 那一天，張曉的命運被一場車禍徹底改寫。她眼看著那輛失控的卡車將自己的靈魂撞出了軀體，而她，既沒有進醫院也沒有進天堂，卻是被撞進了清朝的宮廷中。就像鋪天蓋地的穿越小說裏寫的那樣，張曉的靈魂跨過時間的隧道，在一個叫馬爾泰.若曦的十六歲清朝女孩的體內，重生了…時年，康熙第四十三。天下太平，但一場震動歷史的「九龍奪嫡」正在暗潮湧動。權利的廝殺，愛情的灼燒，在被無限放大的歷史舞臺上，張曉，不，是馬爾泰•若曦的命運無可避免的與眾位親王阿哥們交織在一起…她知道自己不該捲入這場九王奪嫡的爭鬥中，可心不由己，因為這裡有她所愛的，也有愛著她的…若曦最後選擇的究竟是溫潤如玉的八阿哥，還是面冷心熱的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人?等歷史的風雲過後，可以陪她看夕陽西下、雲捲雲舒的又將是誰？

programme.title: 聖水洞之吻(完)
programme.desc: 【年下實習生朴所羅門戀年上工作狂金智恩，吻出姊弟戀化學效應！！】業界能力頂級的行銷組組長姜娜恩，雖是個性冷血的工作狂，但能交出亮眼的工作成績單。遇上公司內MZ世代又期待戀愛的實習生蘇恩浩，兩人上年下的相處，因年齡及價值觀不同互相嫌棄。卻因意外接吻捲入「靈魂交換」事件。之後兩人會發生什麼有趣的事呢?

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【改編人氣美國影集，張東健×朴炯植聯手成為法律界黃金拍檔！！】頭腦聰明，擁有過目不忘天才能力的高延宇，卻因家境關係卻步成為律師。混進了律師事務所遇上韓國頂級資深律師崔江錫。隨著事件發生與時間相處成為黃金拍檔，崔江錫要如何亦師亦友的帶著沒有正式唸過大學也只是菜鳥律師的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 雙軌
programme.desc: 【何與×虞書欣偽骨科繼兄妹禁忌愛戀，從愛妹到曖昧火花四射！！】姜暮9歲前是被家人寵在手心的小女孩，靳朝是天之驕子的哥哥。那年父母離婚，兩人命運自此走上雙軌，爸爸和哥哥移居泰國，成為地下賽車與拳場中的修車工。多年後，19歲的姜暮得知哥哥是被領養的秘密，瞞著所有人獨自飛往泰國。在泰國的租屋中兩人展開了一段隱秘而甜蜜的情感旅程，在光明與黑暗間重逢，禁忌拉扯中雙向救贖。

programme.desc: Xuli, Lars and Glitch argue over whose vehicle is the best; the Vroomster, the Truckster or the Grimbler. Kyan suggests the only way to settle the argument is a race. A sudden waterspout helps Glitch take an early lead, but Ubercorn warns them about the much larger tornadic waterspouts that can sometimes appear. When the weather turns, Glitch and the Go Jetters find themselves in trouble. Can they get to safety before a huge tornado hits the island?

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Pirate Peril, Jamaica
programme.desc: While Xuli and Lars help some local divers explore the underwater ruins of Port Royal, Jamaica, Glitch sets off in search of treasure buried by his great-great-great-uncle, Captain Grimbeard. But his efforts cause silt to churn up from the seabed, trapping Lars under the water. Will Xuli manage to get him free before his air runs out?

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S24 - James the Super Engine
programme.desc: When James hears the children of Sodor talking about their latest comic book superhero, he imagines that he too can become a hero.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S03 - Ribbon Alvida
programme.desc: An excited Sarah and Duck take the Shallots to see the Ribbon Sisters perform with their family circus.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S02 - Outside Outside
programme.desc: The Shallots want to explore beyond the front garden, so Sarah comes up with a plan.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Sofa
programme.desc: Stanley has to fix Myrtles wobbly sofa so her and her friends can watch Fred and Fifi on the Boogie Woogie Dance Show together. He ends up creating a super-duper special sofa.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Holiday
programme.desc: Seamus has booked the wrong date for his and Little Woo's holiday. Stanley repurposes the locations of the town into activities and sights to give them a holiday in a day.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - That Is SO Bad!
programme.desc: From being cheeky - like eating lots of sweets or watching TV when you're not supposed to - the funny animals chat about what it's like to misbehave.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S02 - It's Time to Search for Seashells
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran are at the beach and begin to look for lots of different types of shells. They also discover a rock pool, some limpets and a hermit crab - which runs away! JoJo realises that all the different elements at the beach make up an ecosystem, so she shouldn't take any shells home.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Magic
programme.desc: Bluey teaches Bingo how to use magic so she can make Mum play with her, but she forgets to explain the most important rule: never use magic for cheekiness.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Chest
programme.desc: Dad tries to teach Bluey how to play chess, but Mum thinks she is still too young. When Bingo joins in, the kids make up their own rules, but they still can't beat Dad.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Sheep Dog
programme.desc: Dad agrees to play Sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum who is taking a well-earned rest, but looking after a sheep is harder work than they expected.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - Tag's First Day
programme.desc: The Squirrels are crafting in the Clubhouse when Betty saves Tag from throwing water across the table instead of glitter.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Library Badge
programme.desc: When the Squirrels can't figure out if fish have noses, Duggee shows them his library. But when the Squirrels realise no-one is visiting it, they have an idea..

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Ping Pong Penguins
programme.desc: What’s that bouncy, pingy, whacking sound? It’s the Penguins playing ping-pong!

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Forbidden City, China
programme.desc: What is that awful noise coming from the Gulou Tower? It's Grandmaster Glitch dressed up as a Chinese Emperor singing of course! Go Jetters to the rescue!

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S02 - Banana
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Banana revealing yet another astonishing secret about herself in the opera piece, "I've Got a Secret"

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S02 - Cabbage
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the marvelous Cabbage and his dazzling super-veggie memory skills.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Operation Kiwi
programme.desc: Supertato, Carrot and Tomato are exploring in the plant aisle when they hear a strange noise. They follow the noise and meet the famous Kiwi the Explorer, who needs their help.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Museum Mischief
programme.desc: Evil Pea pretends to help Supertato and Carrot train for crime prevention, but she tricks them and steals a mobile phone. Supertato and Carrot have a clever plan to get it back.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Cheerleading Badge

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Waiting Badge

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The A Cappella Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are inspired to learn how to sing a cappella style after hearing a famous bird quartet singing in a nearby tree.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Topiary Badge
programme.desc: When the Squirrels see Duggee practicing his impressive Topiary skills they are keen to try some of their own - and promptly put their new talents into practice in order to tame some very wild woods!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Favourite Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn what a favourite is, but have trouble deciding what their own favourite things are, so they make a film asking some of their friends what is special to them to help narrow it down.

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Floating Farms, Bangladesh
programme.desc: While clearing up the Academy farm after a heavy storm, the Go Jetters wish they could keep the plants above water. Glitch remembers a place where the farmers do just that - Bangladesh, where many farmers grow their crops on wooden platforms to avoid floods in the monsoon season. Glitch, Tala, Lars and Foz head to Bangladesh to see these floating farms, but after the Grimbots accidentally knock the Grimmer into a raft, Tala and a local farmer are swept into a nearby river! Glitch and the Go Jett

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Go Jet Academy: Waterspout Wipeout
programme.desc: Xuli, Lars and Glitch argue over whose vehicle is the best; the Vroomster, the Truckster or the Grimbler. Kyan suggests the only way to settle the argument is a race. A sudden waterspout helps Glitch take an early lead, but Ubercorn warns them about the much larger tornadic waterspouts that can sometimes appear. When the weather turns, Glitch and the Go Jetters find themselves in trouble. Can they get to safety before a huge tornado hits the island?

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S24 - Thomas' Not So Lucky Day
programme.desc: It's Friday the 13th in Italy and Thomas tries to improve his luck by following Lorenzo and Beppe's advice on superstitions.

programme.desc: The Shallots want to explore beyond the front garden, so Sarah comes up with a plan.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S02 - Umbrella Bubbles
programme.desc: After getting muddy, Umbrella has to brave his fear of getting wet and take his first bath!

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Stuck
programme.desc: Stanley has to free Myrtle, who is stuck, using his new tunnelling mole machine so she can attend the schools tree planting day.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Sofa

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - Your Brother is Really Naughty
programme.desc: The talking animals chat about all the good and bad things about having a brother or a sister.

Instead, they buy fruit, and JoJo soon realises that ice lollies can be made at home by freezing fruit juice.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Housework
programme.desc: Mum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly, but that's never going to happen, so they end up trying the same approach themselves.

programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-­Laa follow a trail of muddy footprints and find Po in bed with very muddy feet. The Noo-­Noo cleans off the mud.

programme.title: The Swift Knight
programme.desc: The Ming Emperor is dying with no heir to succeed the throne. His brother recalls that he has an illegitimate child with a court lady years ago and palace guards are sent to search for the heir. When the Emperor's nephew hires assassins to kill the child so he can be the successor, the Swift Knight comes to the rescue...

programme.title: The Empress Dowager
programme.desc: Award-winning drama featuring a passionate performance by Lisa Lu, enhanced by sumptuous costumes and sets, produces a powerful, fascinating story. In five thousand years of Chinese history, there was never a more fascinating woman than the dragon lady of the Ching Dynasty, also the Empress Dowager, who was the power behind the throne for the last half of the 19th century. The vast tapestry of palace intrigues is vividly brought to the screen.

programme.title: A Taste Of Cold Steel
programme.desc: Gan Dai Xiong is killed by Prince Wu, who seeks to seize his Purple Sword. Prince Wu's son join forces with an evil gang to steal the Purple Sword from Gan Dai Xiong's three daughters. Eventually, Gan's daughters team up with their cousin Xu to avenge their father's death.

programme.title: Vengeance
programme.desc: Yu Lou is betrayed by his wife and eventually killed by her lover, Fung, who is the boss of a martial arts school. Yu Lou's brother, Xiao Lou, knows about his tragic death and is determined to take revenge for him.

programme.title: One Way Only
programme.desc: Danny is a motorbike workshop owner, once was a renowned motorcycle racer, but were seriously injured in an illegal race. Mai, student of Danny, wins a race in Macau under Danny's help. However, because of money and honour, Mai joins illegal races. After knowing this, Li persuades Mai to stop illegal races, but Mai seems cannot find his way out...

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: The formidable swordswoman Silver Fox was a child when her father was senselessly wounded by his step brother, and her mother raped. It is payback time eighteen years later, as her father trains her up with kung fu to take revenge on his behalf.

programme.title: Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: Hua, a clever beauty, teams up with her brother to stage a jewel heist and plans to sell the loot in Singapore. To evade customs, she slips a diamond ring into the pocket of a fellow passenger, Zhang Zhi Xian, only to lose him after landing. Forced to track him down, Hua resorts to a series of clumsy schemes to get close and retrieve the ring.

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandit's son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his "Crazy Lo Han Fist" improves with every fight.

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: Carefree drifters Meng Gang and Tie Hu discover their purpose after meeting the revolutionary leader, Wan Tai. With the help of Meng Gang's girlfriend, they infiltrate a warlord camp to seize weapons for the revolutionary cause. Following a fierce battle, all three make the ultimate sacrifice, becoming the "Anonymous Heroes" of the revolution.

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: Vengeance Of A Snow Girl
programme.desc: A crippled woman seeks vengeance against the four men who killed her parents. However, when she crosses path with a young warrior who falls in love with her, trouble ensues as his father is one of the killers responsible for her family's massacre years ago.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: Buddha's Palm
programme.desc: Young Long Jian Fei, a martial arts novice, is adopted by the Fire Spirit Demon who taught him the powerful Buddha's Palm, turning Long into a martial arts master. Long is tasked by the Fire Spirit Demon to takes revenge for his master, and this soon unleashes a storm upon the martial arts world...

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Mui's embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love...

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Mui's embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love...

programme.title: The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: The Yang Generals were ambushed by the enemies and only two of the sons survived. The fifth son of Yang's escapes to Shaolin temple and learns the pole-fighting techniques from the monks, eventually creating his own "Eight Diagram Pole Fight" and teaming up with the Shaolin monks to avenge his family.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him?

programme.title: Hell Has No Boundary
programme.desc: Cheng Chung (Derek Yee) and May (Liu Hsueh-hua), a pair of lovers working on the police force, camp on an outlying island. Awakened by a strange sound, May goes out onto the beach where a violent frenzy grips her. After her return from leave, May insists Inspector Wang (Yueh Hua) in a bid to rescue some hostages. She shoots the thug under most peculiar circumstances. Then a series of tragedies occur. Her two colleagues die mangled in a lift accident and Inspector Wang is injured at his desk by a

programme.title: The Knight of Knights
programme.desc: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin. Wen saved Lin and battles the abbot to avenge his dead sworn brothers. With Lin and his army's help, they bring down the ruthless monks in the monastery.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperor's sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people but it is also at this time that he helps the needy and cracks the gambling business in Suzhou.

programme.title: The Golden Buddha
programme.desc: A map indicating the location of the Chan's family heirloom is hidden in three Golden Buddha statues. Paul, an insurance agent, finds one statue by chance and Chan's daughter has another one. This makes them targets of treasure-hunting criminals and they have to team up to defeat them before unveiling the hidden secrets.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dong's songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: The Duel of the Century
programme.desc: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel as the two swordsmen never met and do not have any conflicts. He decides to investigate more with Hua Man Lou, and eventually uncovers some hidden conspiracies...

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Continuing the success of the classic comedy "House of 72 tenants", this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood?

programme.title: The Rebel Intruders
programme.desc: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts skills become sworn brothers, and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town when they save a refugee girl. Can they fight back against the rebel gangs?

programme.title: Till the End of Time
programme.desc: Ming marries singer Ling, defying his wealthy father and severing family ties. When Ling becomes pregnant, Ming's overwork causes him to lose his sight. To support their home, Ling returns to the stage but Ming leaves to avoid becoming a burden. Encouraged by a friend, Ling performs again, and her song moves Ming to reunite with his wife and child.

programme.title: The Secret Of The Dirk
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the City of Liu are forced to flee when the vicious Black Tigers gang raids their city, but are able to hide all their gold and treasures in a valley. A team of swordswomen led by Liu wants to get their hands on the treasures before the bandits, but both parties will have to contend with the wandering swordsman Chou for them...

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls' high school, is stuck with a baby that isn't his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: The Kung-fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan. Chow Ping from the Chow Clan is a student of Wong's caught in the Mong's territory and as punishment, the Mong Clan wants to cut off Chow Ping's limbs. Wong steps in to defend his student.

programme.title: The Kung-fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan. Chow Ping from the Chow Clan is a student of Wong's caught in the Mong's territory and as punishment, the Mong Clan wants to cut off Chow Ping's limbs. Wong steps in to defend his student.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: This was one of top three films of 1970 and winner of "Outstanding Drama" at the 9th Golden Horse Awards. The evil minister uses twelve golden medallions to summon war hero Yueh Fei back from the frontline and execute him. A group of wandering warriors, led by Yueh Hua and Chin Ping, try to stop the medallion couriers.

programme.title: The Devil's Mirror
programme.desc: A power-hungry Witch who leads the Bloody Ghouls Clan, seeks two magical mirrors, Wind Mirror and Thunder Mirror, which are owned by Bai and the Wen Clan respectively. She needs both mirrors to find the location of a powerful weapon that will make her invincible and will stop at nothing to get her hands on them.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: Killers Five
programme.desc: The Duke's daughter has been kidnapped by the notorious Golden Dragon Hill bandits. A swordman named Yue Zhen Bei is assigned to save her, and expecting many dangers on the journey, Yue garners help from a group of good friends who are also kung fu masters.

programme.title: Asia-pol
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Xuan trails a shipment of contraband gold being delivered to gang leader, George Eaton. He enlists the help of a Chinese woman who is trying to avenge her sister and narrowly escapes several deadly traps as he closes in on Eaton's location. This spy film is loosely inspired by the James Bond movies.

programme.title: The Bells of Death
programme.desc: Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular "Venom" Lo Meng.

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: The Proud Youth
programme.desc: Ling Hu Chong, a Huashan clan's disciple, is assigned to find the successor to the score "The Proud One". Ling identifies Ying for the score but finds out that she is the daughter of the evil clan's leader. At the same time, he is unwittingly dragged into an epic power struggle between clans, with complicated allegiances and perplexing moralities.

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Hui's husband finds out about them, he hurts Hui and causes her to become seriously ill, while also blackmails Ha. How will this love story end?

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: When Qiao Miao is about to kill the bandit whom he just met, he is attracted by her beauty and they quickly fall in love. The two later discover the blood feud between the owner of the unique weapon - "Twelve Deadly Coins" and the old master who controls the bandit...

programme.title: The Singing Escort
programme.desc: Betty Ting plays Susan, a young woman hiding from her father by being a nightclub singer in Japan. Pop singer Chao Ke-jen (Lin Chong) gets permission from his boss to visit Japan, with the condition that he finds the boss's daughter. Boy finds girl, boy falls in love. But will the father approve?

programme.desc: In 1920s Shanghai, Chen Zhen goes undercover as a businessman to expose a mob boss's collaboration with the Japanese. While gaining his trust, he must also combat a wave of assassins sent by a brutal Japanese general. Fighting from the shadows in a black mask, he allies with a police captain to protect the city's patriots with his formidable fists.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student’s family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife’s debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find “The Sutra of 42 Chapters”. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise.

programme.title: Gorgeous
programme.desc: A romantic message in a bottle sends Taiwanese girl Ah Bu on a quest to Hong Kong to find its author, Albert. Disheartened when he turns out to be nothing like she imagined, she prepares to return home. However, her plans take an unexpected turn when she encounters Chan, a wealthy tycoon, and an unlikely romance begins to bloom.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the other’s true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveller
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveller

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him…

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika’s mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn…

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong’s biggest stars

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau’s Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city’s casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian’s daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond…

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: The Bullet Vanishes
programme.desc: A series of murders at a munitions factory sparks fear of a “Phantom Bullet” that kills without a trace. Detective Song Dong Lu and sharpshooter Guo Zhui are tasked with solving the case. As they uncover layers of corruption and conspiracy, they are drawn into a deadly game where the truth is more dangerous than the bullets.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: The Mad Monk

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master

On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Prince Charming

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom. Later, Ying discovers that she is pregnant but no one can remember

programme.title: The Comeback

When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua’s hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Mr Vampire

When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop

When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei’s possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.
